description: A spec.md that grows past the 150-line budget (SKILL.md process step 4: 'If you exceed it, the feature is too big') must be caught by validate-artifacts.sh, not shipped silently. Guards against the safety net rush-spec's own process step 8 relies on going silent.

given.scenario: Fixture project containing specs/001-fixture/spec.md, deliberately 182 lines (budget is 150). Represents a spec a rushed /rush-spec run left over budget.
